What I Do

Helping brands earn
the trust their products deserve.

I work with internationally expanding brands whose product is ready — but whose brand presence hasn't caught up. More than content. Market credibility.

— First

Market audit & research.

Before anything else, I understand how your brand currently appears to buyers in the market you're entering — what's working, what's invisible, what's quietly losing trust.

— Then

Brand building & adapting.

Positioning, messaging, and identity work that translates your product strength into something a Western audience actually understands, trusts, and chooses.

— Always

Execution & presence.

Strategic bilingual content, partnerships, and ongoing communications that build a credible presence month over month — not just posts, a system.

About
EN English FR Français 中 中文 ES Español
— Zhenai Xiao · 肖珍爱

I help brands speak the language of the markets they're entering — credibly, consistently, and strategically.

I'm a Communications & Market Development Consultant based in Montréal, Canada. My career has been shaped inside the institutions that define how Western countries communicate with the world — federal government, public diplomacy, international advocacy.

That experience is the foundation of how I work with brands today. I've written for cabinet ministers, advised foreign governments, and worked across four languages and three continents. The same precision and cultural fluency that institutional communications demand are exactly what's required when a brand wants to be taken seriously in a new market.

I work primarily with Chinese brands expanding into North America — where strong products alone no longer earn trust. Western buyers evaluate brand presence, consistency, and cultural fluency before they ever evaluate the product itself. My role is to close that gap.

Engagement

How working together works.

A small roster. Real strategic depth.

I take on a limited number of clients at any time. Most work is structured as a monthly retainer — long enough to build something credible, short enough to stay accountable to results. Engagements start with an audit, not a contract.

Currently accepting · Two new clients for 2026

  • iii.

  • iv.
